title: AI Marketing Automation for Small Businesses: A Complete Guide

facts.fact: The page defines AI marketing automation as using artificial intelligence to handle and improve marketing tasks automatically, such as sending emails, posting on social media, segmenting customers, and nurturing leads.
facts.quote: It basically means using artificial intelligence to handle and improve marketing jobs automatically.

facts.fact: The page names HubSpot, Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, and Zoho as examples of popular AI marketing automation platforms.
facts.quote: Some popular ones are HubSpot, Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, and Zoho.

facts.fact: The page states that many AI marketing automation tools are built for small businesses, with features that scale and prices that are reasonable, but it gives no specific prices.
facts.quote: Lots of tools are made just for small ones, with features that grow with you and prices that make sense.
